entities.summary: Chang Hsiao-yen ; born 11 August 1948) is a Taiwanese television host and actress. Born in Shanghai, Chang relocated to Taiwan amid the Chinese Civil War and started her career at the age of five as a child actor. In 1958, she received her first Best Child Actress award at the Asia Pacific Film Festival, a recognition she would earn for three consecutive years. In the 1980s, Chang gained wide popularity for hosting the CTS variety show Variety 100 (綜藝100). She is also known for hosting television shows such as Weekend Pie (週末派), Super Sunday (超級星期天), Million-Dollar Class (百萬小學堂) and SS Hsiao-yen Night (SS小燕之夜).
